incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — SEV-2 — repeated quota-enforce errors for tenant: acct-42 (rate limiter anomaly). Auto-page group: ops-incidents. Pager: pagerduty-bot

pagerduty-bot: Pager triggered, incident id PD-98312. Escalation policy: ops-incidents -> on-call -> team-lead.

mike_ops: seeing a spike in 429s from the quota-mapper logs, looks like quota tags flipping between 'standard' and 'restricted' every ~30s for acct-42.

elaine_prod: confirmed from the logs: `quota_updater` is emitting duplicate tag updates. Could be propagation loop with config-sync.

raj_sre: are we getting repeated pages? I just got paged twice in last 6 mins.

beth_cs: customer (acct-42) reporting degraded UX in chat — messages fail intermittently. They see sustained 429 for some requests.

mike_ops: attaching recent log excerpt: ```
2026-02-10T12:08:03Z quota-mapper INFO apply_tag acct-42 -> restricted
2026-02-10T12:08:33Z quota-mapper INFO apply_tag acct-42 -> standard
2026-02-10T12:09:03Z quota-mapper INFO apply_tag acct-42 -> restricted
```

elaine_prod: hmm, config-sync Helm release 'quota-policies' was rolled out ~12:00UTC. Could be a rollout with flaky leader-election.

raj_sre: paging is noisy — recommend disabling auto-pager for this alert group temporarily and throttle PD notifications. @pagerduty-bot can you suppress for 15m?

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged. Suppressing duplicate alerts for incident id PD-98312 for 15 minutes.

mike_ops: mitigation plan: 1) mark acct-42 as sticky to 'standard' in quota-mapper state to stop oscillation 2) restart quota-mapper pods to clear in-memory race 3) temporarily bump tenant shard route to dedicated-pool to reduce customer impact.

elaine_prod: agree. I can apply sticky tag via API: `POST /internal/quota/sticky?tenant=acct-42&tag=standard` — would that hold?

raj_sre: do it, but first snapshot current mapping: `kubectl get configmap quota-mapper-snapshot -o yaml > /tmp/qsnap.yaml`

mike_ops: executing now. ```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/quota/sticky" -d '{"tenant":"acct-42","tag":"standard","ttl_s":3600}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN"
```

mike_ops: sticky tag applied, response 200.

elaine_prod: rolling restart quota-mapper to pick up leader/stability fix: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/quota-mapper -n infra`

sara_engineer: monitoring logs and metrics — saw tag flips stop immediately after sticky applied. 429 rate dropped from 18% -> 2% over 3 mins. CPU on quota-mapper still high but stable.

beth_cs: messaging back to customer: "We're investigating an internal quota routing issue; temporary mitigation applied and we expect service to stabilize in a few minutes. We'll follow up with a postmortem."

mike_ops: also added an emergency route for acct-42: `route override -> dedicated-pool` queued and applied via infra console. Verified requests are now routed to dedicated-pool.

raj_sre: good. Now to prevent noisy pages: recommend creating a suppression rule for 'quota_tag_oscillation' alert to reduce autopager churn and add a debounce of 2 minutes in alerting rule.

elaine_prod: logging a quick PR to add debounce and a guard for duplicate tag updates in quota-updater: `gh pr create --title "debounce: quota tag flapping prevention" --body "adds 2m debounce and duplicate-check"`

incident-bot: Incident PD-98312 acknowledged by mike_ops.

pagerduty-bot: PD-98312 ack by mike_ops at 12:20UTC. Escalations paused.

mike_ops: after mitigation, customer impact metric: errors for acct-42 dropped to 0.8% over next 15m, latency normal. Marking as mitigated.

beth_cs: notified customer they can resume traffic, asked for a brief post-incident call tomorrow.

raj_sre: creating short postmortem stub: - summary - timeline - root cause (config-sync race leading to duplicate tag writes) - mitigation steps applied - follow-ups (debounce PR, alert suppression, add sticky fallback).

elaine_prod: follow-up: add integration test for config-sync leader election and idempotent tag writes.

sara_engineer: monitoring for 30m window. No further oscillations seen.

mike_ops: closing the incident thread here — will upload logs and timeline to the incident tracker (link: https://incidents.internal/PD-98312). Thx everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-98312 marked as mitigated.
